text:
morgan: kicking off prod deploy rwd-infer v2.3.1 in us-west1 at 22:30 PST. Canary 10% for 15m. I'll run basic sanity + perf checks. ping @tess @alex if anything odd.

alex: who's on rollback? do we have the one-click rollback ready?

morgan: @devops set up rollback runbook earlier today — command is below. will keep it on hand.

```
kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deployment/rwd-infer --to-revision=42
# or via infra-cli: infra deploy rollback --service rwd-infer --rev 42
```

deploy-bot: Deployment rwd-infer:v2.3.1 started (canary=10%) — build bld-20260317-981

tess: watching latency / p50/p95 dashboards, will alert if p95 > 600ms. enabling extra tracing for canary :eyes:

sam: running smoke request set: /generate with prompt "hello" x5 then check KV cache behavior. i'll paste results.

sam: quick snippet I used:
```
for i in {1..5}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-infer-v2","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/generate | jq -r .status; done
```

maria: doing embedding sanity — sampling 100 reqs from recent traffic vs prod baseline.

devops: rollback command is tested. if promoting fails we can flip the traffic back to v2.2.x with infra-cli:
infra traffic set rwd-infer --version v2.2.8 --percent 100

morgan: canary reports healthy after 5m. quick health checks:
- errors: 0 spikes
- p50: 120ms (baseline 110ms)
- p95: 530ms (baseline 510ms)
- token cost per req: stable

maria: embedding cosine distribution looks within baseline variance. no drift detected :thumbsup:

tess: no new errors in Sentry for canary, traces look clean. watching for 10m.

alex: ok to promote to 100% in 10m if no regressions. @morgan confirm.

morgan: confirmed. promoting in 10. leaving this thread for status. will post final /rollback-ready if needed.

deploy-bot: Traffic promotion scheduled: canary -> 100% in 10m (triggered by morgan)

morgan: promotion done. final checks running.

morgan: final status: deployment 100% successful. metrics:
- errors last 30m: 0 -> +1 (minor 502 from upstream resolve, investigated)
- p95 last 30m: 540ms -> acceptable
- rollbacks: none
closing: all good, moving to monitoring. thanks team :tada:
